entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Finally, a person! I've been on hold for twenty minutes! I want to return this helmet I bought. This is absolutely ridiculous.

I certainly apologize for the wait time, sir. I can definitely look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? The color is completely wrong! It looks nothing like the picture on your website. I don't trust the safety of a product from a company that can't even get the color right. Just process the return. I don't even want to look at it, the box is still unopened.

I completely understand your frustration. Getting an item that doesn't match your expectations is not the experience we want for our customers. I just need to pull up your account to get started. May I have your order number?
It's 78-45-BINGO. And you'd better fix this, or I swear I'm getting your manager on the line and leaving a review on every single website I can find.

I understand, sir. Let me take care of this for you. One moment while I pull up order 78-45-BINGO... Okay, I see it here. The purchase date was 55 days ago. Our policy for a standard item like this helmet is a 90-day return window.
So? What does that mean? Are you going to help me or just waste more of my time reading rules to me?

It means you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. I can process this return for you immediately. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. You should see it in your inbox within the next couple of minutes.
Oh. A full refund? Just like that?

Yes, absolutely. Just print that label, attach it to the shipping box with the unopened helmet inside, and drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the refund back on your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Huh. Okay. Well... that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You are very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
